I don't have any notes on Isaiah 1 for you yet. None of the source pages made it back to me in a form I could read, so I have nothing sourced to report.

I tried to load six pages at once: the Enduring Word commentary on Isaiah 1, the Precept Austin Isaiah 1 page, the Ellicott, Gill and Pulpit Commentary pages on biblehub.com, and the NET Bible notes. The results came back in a format I didn't expect, and my code failed before it could show me any text. When I tried to look at what had come back, the tool said I had used up my allowed calls for this turn.

You told me to report only what the pages say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I couldn't read any page, writing verse notes now would mean filling every gap from memory, so I haven't written any.

If you ask me to go ahead in a new message, I can do the full research:
1. **The traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** each tradition's own teachers on the allowed sites, such as Wesley's notes for "wash and cleanse yourselves" (v. 16) and Reformed and Baptist preaching on "let us reason together" (v. 18).
3. **Other views, where well known:** the NET Bible notes and Bible Odyssey for modern scholarship, and New Advent, Catholic.com and OCA for Catholic and Orthodox readings.

Each point will be written verse by verse ("v. 4: …") with its URL.
